comment: Sizes (GiB) for the cache steps scripts/ci/check-cache-budget.mjs derives from the workflows. `measured` overrides by workflow:job (rust-cache) or by the derived key name (go-cache, npm-cache), each read from `gh api actions/caches` on the date in `measuredOn`; `estimates` cover what has no main entry yet; `fixed` are entries no step of these kinds writes. The nightly janitor (ci-image-cleanup.yml) warns when the cache drifts from this plan by more than 1 GiB. 2026-11-20: registry-only rust-cache entries measured 0.03-0.6 GiB (0.4 for the libs/rust lock), so none is planned any more. ci-desktop.yml:desktop: the two targets' dependencies measured 1.17 GiB compressed in the job (2026-11-20, no dev debug info), plus its registry and git (1.2 GiB on disk, already compressed crates).
